| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token | Obtain an access token using client or user credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2 | Search for Account ID | (Optional) Use this step to find the from account ID if it is not already known. |
| 3 | Search for Recipient Profile | (Optional) Retrieve recipient profile information, such as member number, passcode (last 3 characters of the recipient's last name), and email address. |
| 4 | Search for Recipient Account ID | (Optional) Retrieve recipient account information, such as account number and account type. |
| 5 | Create Validate-Recipient Transfer | Submit a transfer to a recipient after validating the recipient profile and account information. |
